Title: [WWW] Wizards's web site redesigned - update your links!

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
As advertised, the Wizards of the Coast web pages have been redesigned,
renamed, and restructured.

The main VtES page is now back at:
http://www.wizards.com/VTES/Welcome.html

The tournaments that make up Crusade: World are listed at:
http://www.wizards.com/VTES/VTES_Tournaments.html

The Card Lists are at:
http://www.wizards.com/VTES/VTES_Cardsets.html
(with individual splash pages: Jyhad.html, Vampire.html,
Dark_Sovereigns.html, Ancient_Hearts.html, and Sabbat.html)
The individual card lists are the same as always, however,
with all the old typos, so don't bother downloading them
expecting them to be fixed.

Complete information on the new web structure is available at
http://www.wizards.com/Thankyou.html

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
